mapper.select: select id,guild_kind,guild_id,status,del_flag,archive_reason,archived_at,perm_version from im_channel where id=#{id} and guild_kind=#{guildKind} and guild_id=#{guildId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into im_channel_lifecycle_receipt(operator_id,request_id,payload_fingerprint,create_time) values(#{actor},#{requestId},#{fingerprint},current_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update operator_id=operator_id
mapper.select: select payload_fingerprint,response_json from im_channel_lifecycle_receipt where operator_id=#{actor} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
mapper.update: update im_channel_lifecycle_receipt set response_json=#{response} where operator_id=#{actor} and request_id=#{requestId} and response_json is null
